purpose: Give one corrective retry after a structured-output answer failed validation, naming the failures without naming the fix, so the recovery rate measures the model rather than the prompt.

error_summary.description: The validator's own failure list, one per line. Failures are stated, never corrected: a repair prompt that supplies the answer measures the prompt.

schema_json.description: Canonical JSON of the same schema the first attempt was given, repeated because the corrective turn must not depend on the model remembering it.

expectations: One JSON document conforming to the supplied schema, with no surrounding text.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: benchmark catalog §3.5 measures recovery rate after one corrective retry, and that retry is a prompt like any other rather than a string literal in the runner.
